description: Spec #3147 ST-1: the application command surface the built-in windows receive. build.rs registers an application manifest (tauri_build::AppManifest::commands), so from now on no command reaches a window unless a capability grants it. This capability grants the app-manifest default permission set (permissions/app/default.toml) to exactly the built-in window class, so the shipped applications keep every command they had before the gate was turned on. It deliberately does NOT match installed-*: an installed application must match no capability at all, which is the refusal AC-2 depends on.
